A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing a grant for the activities of the Minnesota Youth Council; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; MINNESOTA YOUTH COUNCIL. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]
